entity: Silicon Valley Bank / SVB Financial Group
scandal_summary: SVB collapsed on March 10, 2023, just 14 days after KPMG signed a clean opinion. SVB had $15.1B of unrealized losses on a $91B HTM Treasury/MBS portfolio, funded by 87% uninsured demand deposits concentrated in tech/VC. The Fed raised rates 425bp during 2022. The asset-liability duration mismatch (6.2-year assets vs near-zero deposits) was disclosed in footnotes but not flagged in the audit opinion. KPMG issued no going-concern or emphasis-of-matter paragraph.
key_red_flags_that_should_have_been_rais: $15.1B unrealized losses on HTM portfolio — economically the same loss as if classified AFS; classification shifted opacity but did not eliminate economic exposure
87% uninsured deposit concentration — extraordinary liquidity risk; deposit flight risk not theoretical
Deposit concentration in tech/VC sector (>50%) — sector-specific depositor correlation (when VC funding slows, all depositors withdraw simultaneously)
3x asset growth in 2 years ($71B -> $212B) funded by concentrated deposits — growth beyond risk-management capacity
Asset-liability duration mismatch: 6.2-year assets vs near-zero deposits — textbook ALM risk
Fed raised rates 425bp during 2022 — direct macro trigger amplifying duration risk; should have triggered going-concern re-evaluation
KPMG 20+ year tenure — long tenure has well-documented association with delayed going-concern modifications
No going-concern or emphasis-of-matter paragraph despite $15B unrealized losses on collateral — clean opinion 14 days before failure is implausible
CEO stock sale Feb 27, 2023 (3 days after opinion) under 10b5-1 plan adopted Jan 26 — auditors should consider insider-trading signals when assessing going concern

expected_judgement_axes.evidence_sufficiency: Sufficient — the disclosed unrealized losses and deposit concentration were material enough to warrant an emphasis-of-matter paragraph and a serious going-concern assessment.
expected_judgement_axes.independence_concern: Moderate — 20+ year KPMG tenure created a comfort dynamic.
expected_judgement_axes.going_concern: Going-concern modification warranted by liquidity mismatch and rate trajectory; clean opinion failed to consider correlated depositor flight.
